strategies.label: MAESTRO, most confident 10%
strategies.desc: The multi-agent system: it reads the market regime, forecasts the next 30 minutes with two deep-learning models, and trades only its 10% most confident calls.

strategies.label: MAESTRO, every signal
strategies.desc: The same forecasts with no confidence filter, so it acts on every up or down call.

strategies.label: MAESTRO as designed
strategies.desc: Trades only when confidence clears the thresholds it was designed with. In 39 months it never did, so it never traded.

strategies.label: Logistic regression
strategies.desc: Looks at the last five 5-minute moves and predicts whether the next one is up or down.

strategies.label: Bollinger bands
strategies.desc: Buys when the price is unusually low for the last 100 minutes and sells when it is unusually high.

strategies.label: Contrarian
strategies.desc: Bets that the last 15 minutes of movement will reverse.

strategies.label: Linear regression, 5 moves
strategies.desc: Fits a straight line through the last five moves to predict the next one.

strategies.label: Linear regression, 1 move
strategies.desc: Predicts the next move from the last one alone. This is the model behind the MSc's 37.6% figure.

strategies.label: Moving-average crossover
strategies.desc: Follows the trend when the 20-bar average crosses the 200-bar average.

strategies.label: Coin flip
strategies.desc: Picks up or down at random every 5 minutes. It should lose roughly what its trades cost, and it does.

strategies.label: Buy and hold
strategies.desc: Buys EUR/USD at the start of each test month and holds it to the end.
